descriptor.name: Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current (IndianaMap) — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: Indiana Geographic Information Office / IndianaMap; county parcel data
descriptor.scope: Indiana statewide parcel boundaries, all 92 counties. state_parcel_id is the Indiana state parcel number (county-coded, normally 18 digits).
caveats: Rows with null or blank state_parcel_id (7,540 statewide on 2026-10-12) are excluded; 9,637 non-blank values are not 18 characters and 1,062 contain spaces, all kept verbatim.
Same endpoint as us-in-marion-indianapolis-parcels (county_id=49, key local_id under US-IN-MARION-); Marion County parcels would exist under both namespaces with different keys.
Layer also publishes property address and tax-district fields, which are not requested.
descriptor.attribution: IndianaMap / Indiana Geographic Information Office and Indiana counties. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: IndianaMap service "Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current" compiles county parcels; all 92 county_id values present on 2026-10-12.
